# EverSafe Fire Protection

> Florida fire protection engineering firm based in Central Florida. Registered Florida engineering firm, FBPE Registry No. 40449. Every deliverable is prepared or reviewed by a Florida-licensed Professional Engineer (PE). Serves MEP firms, general contractors, sprinkler and alarm contractors, architects, and building owners. Florida projects only. Contact: 386-837-4057, info@eversafe-fire.com.

## Services

Services are organized in three groups.

### 1. Review and seal
You have drawings. You need a Florida PE seal.
- [Plan Review & PE Stamping](https://eversafe-fire.com/pe-stamping-plan-review.html): Third-party review and PE sealing of contractor sprinkler and fire alarm drawings. AHJ comment response.
- [Instant quote and drawing upload](https://eversafe-fire.com/pe-stamping-plan-review.html#quote): Price for PE review, sign and seal in under a minute. After the price shows, you can upload drawings and calcs on the same page (PDF, DWG, DXF, RVT, ZIP, JPG, PNG; up to 100 MB per file, 20 files and 500 MB per quote). Files are stored privately and deleted after 90 days. Quotes are valid for 7 days. Standard turnaround is 5 business days. 48 hour and 24 hour rush are available.

### 2. Design
You need drawings and calculations.
- [Fire Sprinkler System Design](https://eversafe-fire.com/fire-sprinkler-system-design.html): Wet, dry, pre-action, and antifreeze systems per NFPA 13. Hydraulic calculations, water supply analysis, delegated design, PE-stamped shop drawings.
- [High-Piled & Rack Storage Design](https://eversafe-fire.com/high-piled-storage-florida.html): Sprinkler design for warehouses and storage.
- [Fire Alarm & Detection Design](https://eversafe-fire.com/fire-alarm-system-design.html): Device layout, riser diagrams, battery and voltage-drop calculations, sequence of operations, sealed submittals per NFPA 72.
- [Life Safety Plans](https://eversafe-fire.com/life-safety-plans-florida.html): Life safety sheets, egress and occupancy analysis, fire and smoke barrier plans per the FBC and NFPA 101.
- [Special Hazards Design](https://eversafe-fire.com/special-hazards-design-florida.html): Data centers, energy storage systems per NFPA 855, clean agent suppression per NFPA 2001.

### 3. Code and analysis
You need an answer or a report.
- [Fire Code Consulting](https://eversafe-fire.com/fire-code-consulting-florida.html): Code analysis, alternative means and methods support, and FSES worksheets per NFPA 101A.
- [HMIS Inventory Statements](https://eversafe-fire.com/hmis-inventory-statement-florida.html): Hazardous Materials Inventory Statements for hazmat permits per IFC Chapter 50.
- [MAQ Analysis](https://eversafe-fire.com/maq-analysis-florida.html): Maximum Allowable Quantity analysis per IFC Table 5003.1.1.
- [Fire & Smoke Modeling](https://eversafe-fire.com/fire-smoke-modeling-florida.html): Performance-based fire and smoke modeling.
- [Smoke Control Studies](https://eversafe-fire.com/smoke-studies-florida.html): Smoke control rational analysis.

## Who We Serve
- [For MEP Firms](https://eversafe-fire.com/for-mep-firms.html): For firms with no fire protection engineer on staff.
- [For General Contractors](https://eversafe-fire.com/for-general-contractors.html): Sealed delegated-design submittals, PE seals on subcontractor shop drawings, AHJ comment response.

## Turnaround
- Proposals: usually one business day.
- PE review and seal: 5 business days standard. 48 hour and 24 hour rush available.
